flags.title: Extra claude flags

flags.agentHint: Added to every session this agent runs, e.g. --channels plugin:telegram@claude-plugins-official.
flags.sessionRestartText: Kept for this session and put back on every resume. Restarting starts claude again on the same conversation, this time with these flags; the conversation is kept.
flags.sessionResumeText: Kept for this session — it applies when you resume it here.
flags.tabHint: Tab fills in the suggestion; Escape clears the field.

builtinSkill.title: Install the built-in skills?
builtinSkill.text: Clauding ships two skills: one turns a conversation into skills, the other explains the `clauding` command a session uses to register an agent and to show pages in the panel. Claude Code only loads skills from your skills folder, so they have to be written there — the only files this app puts under ~/.claude. You can say no and install them later from the Skills menu.

projects.tokenHowTo: Clauding reads ClickUp with your personal API token. Put it in the macOS Keychain:

projects.tokenReadOnly: The token stays in memory, is never written to disk, and is only used to read.
